law_title: The Consumer Protection (Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions) Rules, 2020
exact_text:
(1) Every complaint filed under sub-section (1) of section 35 or sub-clause (i) of clause (a) of sub-section (1) of section 47 or sub-clause (i) of clause (a) of sub-section (1) of section 58 shall be accompanied by a fee as specified in the Table below, in the form of crossed Demand Draft drawn on a nationalised bank or through electronic mode on the portal:
TABLE OF FEES (Rule 7):
District Commission:
1. Value of goods/services paid up to ₹5,00,000 (Five Lakh): Nil (No fee)
2. Value exceeding ₹5,00,000 up to ₹10,00,000: ₹200
3. Value exceeding ₹10,00,000 up to ₹20,00,000: ₹400
4. Value exceeding ₹20,00,000 up to ₹50,00,000: ₹1,000
State Commission:
5. Value exceeding ₹50,00,000 up to ₹1,00,00,000: ₹2,000
6. Value exceeding ₹1,00,00,000 up to ₹2,00,00,000: ₹2,500
National Commission:
7. Value exceeding ₹2,00,00,000 up to ₹10,00,00,000: ₹5,000
8. Value exceeding ₹10,00,00,000: ₹7,500
(2) The fees specified in sub-rule (1) shall be deposited in the Consumer Welfare Fund or in the name of the Registrar of the concerned Commission.
legal_status_notes: Notified vide G.S.R. 449(E) dated 15 July 2020 w.e.f. 20 July 2020. Free filing for claims up to ₹5 Lakhs.
key_topics: zero fee up to five lakhs
